mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy) and weak consumer spending (RSAFS growth < 0.5% m/m) indicate overheating economy with cooling demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as recession risks rise.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 3.0% AND RSAFS 3m m/m growth < 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing slowdown and weakening economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO < 100 (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST exceeds 1100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 5.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 5.0% (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% m/m) combined with low housing starts (HOUST < 1100.0) indicates cooling labor market and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% (p > 0.05 for negative return rate).
